traits.question_notes: new kid having a hard time transitioning to school. Give him more help and one-on-one time. encourage him to engage with his friends. Just returned from being sick for the week.

last week the kids were all sick and had a new kid that needed more attention. The other kids were getting overwhelmed, and she was getting alittle stressed. Gave herself an internal motivational talk.
talk to them about the process, walk them through it, let them help. Five minute warning for transitions. Tell them each step as they go.
didn't want toddlers sitting down and "learn" things like ABCs and colors. Understood that is how they run thier program and had to adapt.
observe what they are interested in, and adapt.
tried to work it out with teacher first, other teacher didn't want to work with her. Sat down with management, and the other teacher still didn't want to change.
Learned she can't do everything or fix everything. Not everything is going to go her way. She gives 100%
provided real example. She observed the signals
